title: $900 PS5 Pro Selling Out During PlayStation Blackout
description: Despite an ongoing blackout protest against PlayStation hardware, the $900 PS5 Pro is selling out in the US as GTA 6 fever takes hold.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## $900 PS5 Pro Selling Out During PlayStation Blackout Amid GTA 6 Fever

As the gaming community eagerly counts down toward the eventual release of Rockstar Games' blockbuster *GTA 6*, the anticipation is already reshaping the hardware market. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, Sony’s supercharged PS5 Pro console is currently selling out across the United States, driven by an unprecedented wave of GTA 6 fever.

### The Clash Between Protests and Pure Demand

Interestingly, this hardware rush comes in the middle of an ongoing blackout protest targeting PlayStation hardware. A segment of the fan base has previously mobilised, urging players to keep their consoles unplugged indefinitely to voice their discontent.

Despite these coordinated efforts, the sheer gravitational pull of the *GTA 6* phenomenon has proven too powerful to ignore. Demand for the PS5’s most powerful model is currently so intense that third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon are boldly charging as much as $1,300 for the device. This represents a massive, highly lucrative mark-up over its standard $900 MSRP.

### The Ultimate Test for Next-Gen Hardware

Industry observers note that as players prepare for the technical demands of *GTA 6*, investing in top-tier hardware has become a priority for many hardcore enthusiasts. Even with a $900 price tag and the absence of a built-in disc drive sparking debates under the "no disc drive, no buy" mantra, consumer willingness to pay premium prices highlights how massive gaming IPs can completely override consumer resistance.

### Editor's Take

The ability of *GTA 6* to drive hardware sales—even amidst community protests and extreme third-party scalping—is a testament to the franchise's unmatched cultural and commercial weight. Players want the absolute best performance possible for what is shaping up to be the defining game of this generation, and they are willing to pay top dollar to get it.
